notes.title: Update 1.6.18: Full Steam Deck support and bug fixes
notes.content: The game is now fully supported on Steam Deck. Various bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 1.6.3
notes.content: UI-improvements, bug fixes and two new languages: Hungarian and Romanian

notes.title: Update 1.6: 5 new languages and lots of quality-of-life improvements
notes.content:
[b]Finally version 1.6 is released! Full release notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] New languages: Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Vietnamese & Czech.
[*] Map-legends toggle UI
[*] New fast-travel UI
[*] Improvements to Vampire-menu
[*] New SFX
[*] FPS is now unlockable in the main menu settings
[*] Graphical improvements to sprites
[*] Updated gamepad support (now switches input system only when you actually press buttons on a gamepad or keyboard, as opposed to when you connect a gamepad)
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue which caused the mouse to drift off the screen
[*] Fixed an issue that cause the player to be stuck in place after losing a battle
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a crash in battle when using fracture
[*] Fixed an issue that caused berserk to not show properly when activated
[*] Fixed an issue which caused the fast travel icons to appear in the minimap
[*] Fixed an issue that caused jitter when viewing the map
[*] Fixed an issue in which the player marker will appear on the minimap
[*] Fixed an issue which caused travel by boat to not work if vampire view has not been opened.
[*] Fixed an issue which caused some side quests to be hidden
[*] Fixed an issue where female characters appearance weren't saved correctly
[*] Fixed an issue with he/she pronouns
[*] Fixed an issue with where saves would get lost (rare case)
[/list]
